before: A caret after an inline picture that is alone in its paragraph was written to the browser as the paragraph start, so typing could land before the picture.
after: That caret position is not written to the browser selection; the editor keeps the model caret, as it does for other positions the painted text cannot express.
reason: The change only decides where the local browser caret is drawn. It does not change shared document data, operations, awareness, or package formats.
